protocol.name: Small-Scale Overnight Starter Culture
protocol.purpose: Prepare a starter culture from a single bacterial colony for downstream expression or plasmid preparation.
materials: Sterile culture tube or baffled flask

steps.text: Add {{ph:1774024647315-9f03b8d734f3c}} of LB medium containing {{ph:1774024647315-9ce336955a66c}} antibiotic to a sterile culture tube.
Pick a single colony from a fresh plate and inoculate the medium.
Incubate the culture at 37 C with shaking at {{ph:1774024647315-09eb7ed8adca9}} for {{ph:1774024647315-82400c92a18e08}}.
Inspect the culture for turbidity and record the culture ID, date, and plasmid name in the notebook.

protocol.troubleshooting:
Problem: Culture does not grow; Possible cause: Colony was not viable or antibiotic concentration was too high; Solution: Restart from a fresh colony and confirm the correct antibiotic and concentration were used
Problem: Culture appears contaminated; Possible cause: Non-sterile handling during inoculation; Solution: Discard the culture and repeat using stricter sterile technique
